D.
I. O. REU
No 765
Date 16/12/26
Shanghai Municipal Council.
December 15th 1916

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
A memorial service in honour of the late Generals
Huang Hsin 黄兴 and Tsai Ao 蔡锷 was held in the
Sing Woo Tai 新舞台 theatre City at 1 p.m. on the
14th inst. About 2000 persons were present.
Liang Chi Chao 梁启超 Dan Zai Bing 谭延闿 Tsiang
Pah Chi 蒋百里 representing the Vice President and
others made speeches. It was proposed to erect and
equip a public library as a permanent monument to
General Tsai Ao.
The delegates sent from Tientsin to stir up
public feeling in Shanghai against the French have
again requested the Chinese Press to start a newspaper
campaign and have again received an evasive reply.
Zee Kou Liang 徐国樑 the Chief of the City
Police accompanied by the City Police Band visited
the Szochow Guild on the 14th inst to pay his respects
at the coffin of the late General Tsai Ao.
Yang Toheng 杨德晟 the Special Envoy for
foreign affairs left for Peking by train this morning.

Your Obedient Servant,

Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
D.
I. O. REU
第 765 号
日期 1926年12月16日

上海工部局。
1916年12月15日

（印章：上海工部局）
警务处。
（侦探科）

先生：

为悼念已故将军黄兴与蔡锷而举行的追悼会，于本月14日下午1时在市内的新舞台戏院举行。出席者约两千人。

梁启超、谭延闿、蒋百里（代表副总统及其他人士）发表了演说。会议提议建立并装备一座公共图书馆，作为对蔡锷将军的永久纪念。

从天津派来煽动上海民众反法情绪的代表的再次请求中文报界发起报纸宣传运动，但再次得到含糊其辞的答复。

本市警察局局长徐国樑偕同市警察局乐队，于本月14日前往苏州公所，向已故蔡锷将军的灵柩致祭。

外交特派员杨德晟今晨乘火车前往北京。

您顺从的仆人，

侦探副督察。

警务处处长。
